items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Well me and Wilfred was doing this too. On my side they played. Wilfred played and myself outside of the rest of my brothers they didn't, they didn't play no music or nothing.

ctx.x: How much older were you than your little brother Wilfred?
Oh Wilfred? Oh I was way older Wilfred, Wilfred. I guess I was about twenty or fifteen or twenty years old and Wilfred was. Wilfred was my mother's baby child. He was uh, he was the baby boy.
So you had brothers and other brothers and sisters?
